The same ambiguity applies to the dance, music, art and driving 'schools' entries.

issues.claim: Entry count vs. number of verified-openable entries
issues.problem: Roughly 20 of the industrial/wholesale tail entries (Humanicare, Supreme Manufacturing, North Technology, Archtech, Century Packaging, Valley Distributors, Classic Ceramic Tiles, Swan Messenger, Tailwind, Delta Graphics, etc.) cite directories that return HTTP 403 to fetching (Yellow Pages, WhereOrg, Manta, D&B, BBB, njbusinessdirectory extraction failure), so I could not independently open their sources; I confirmed several of their addresses only through search-result snippets. This is a sourcing weakness, not a demonstrated error.
issues.fix: Have triage confirm those by phone before spending time, as the caveats already advise; prefer adding one openable source per entry in the next round.
